;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]], [[Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict]]
**More than 100 people are killed in a [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] airstrike on a detention centre in [[Dhamar, Yemen]], according to the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]]. Saudi Arabia says it hit a [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] military facility used to store drones and missiles, "in accordance with international humanitarian law". [[Iran]] labels the airstrike as a "war crime". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49544559 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/01/world/middleeast/yemen-houthi-saudi-arabia.html (''The New York Times'')] [http://iranpress.com/en/iran-i138063-iran_condemns_saudi_airstrike_on_a_prison_in_yemen's_western_dhamar_province (Iran Press)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**A vehicle triggers a roadside bomb in [[Balkh]], [[Afghanistan]]; all eight civilians on board are killed. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-09/01/c_138355675.htm (Xinhua)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic history of Argentina]], [[Presidency of Mauricio Macri]]
**A [[Necessity and Urgency Decree]] reinstates [[Capital control|currency control]]s in [[Argentina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-economy/argentina-returns-to-currency-controls-as-debt-crisis-spirals-idUSKCN1VM1IH (Reuters)] [https://www.baenegocios.com/economia-finanzas/Cepo-a-la-compra-y-giro-de-divisas-y-exigencia-de-liquidacion-a-exportadores-20190901-0004.html (''Buenos Aires Económico'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires]]
**Troops join volunteers battling wildfires in [[Bolivia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/amazon-fires-soldiers-join-volunteers-battle-fire-190901101353462.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Germany]] and [[Norway]] cease paying into [[the Amazon Fund]], citing concerns over [[Brazil]]'s environmental policies and the role they have played in the fires. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/germany-norway-halt-aid-funding-brazils-amazon-policies-190901123523127.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[flight plan]] transmission computer system fails in [[France]], causing disruption to international flights across Western Europe. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-49541972 (BBC News)] [http://www.leparisien.fr/economie/une-panne-informatique-nationale-perturbe-l-ensemble-du-trafic-aerien-de-nombreux-retards-01-09-2019-8143233.php (''Le Parisien'')]
*[[2019 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Dorian]]
***[[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 5|Category 5]] Hurricane Dorian, with maximum sustained winds of 185 mph (295 km/h), makes landfall on [[Elbow Cay]] in the northern [[The Bahamas|Bahamas]] Abaco islands. The storm is heading west at 7 mph toward [[Grand Bahama]] and the [[Southeastern United States|southeast American coast]]. Storm surges from Dorian, which ties as the second strongest Atlantic hurricane on record, are predicted to be as  high as 23 feet (7 meters) in places. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49541485 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-dorian/dorian-hammers-bahamas-as-second-strongest-atlantic-hurricane-on-record-idUSKCN1VM0YM (Reuters)] [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT5+shtml/011746.shtml (National Hurricane Center)]
*A partially occupied building under construction collapses, killing 15 people in [[Bamako]], [[Mali]]. [https://ewn.co.za/2019/09/02/15-dead-in-mali-building-collapse (AFP via Eyewitness News)] 
*A medical aircraft crashes into a resort in [[Pansol]], [[Philippines]]. All nine on board are killed, with two injuries on the ground. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/plane-crashes-and-bursts-into-flames-in-philippines-killing-all-nine-passengers-on-board-a4226291.html (''The Evening Standard'')]
;International relations
*[[Germany–Poland relations]]
**[[President of Germany|German President]] [[Frank-Walter Steinmeier]] asks [[Poland]]'s forgiveness at a remembrance ceremony in [[Wieluń]], Poland, attended together with [[President of Poland|Polish President]] [[Andrzej Duda]]. The heads of state commemorate [[Nazi Germany]]'s [[bombing of Wieluń]] on the first day of [[World War II]], the world's bloodiest conflict, 80 years ago. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190901-germany-asks-poland-forgiveness-80-years-after-outbreak-wwii (France 24)]

;Law and crime
*[[Gun politics in the United States]]
**New laws come into effect in the state of [[Texas]] that allow for less [[Gun control|restrictions on the carrying of guns]] in "schools, places of worship, foster homes where children live and apartments". [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/new-texas-laws-loosening-gun-control-draw-outrage-advocates-after-n1048746 (NBC News)]
